Top News
 
 
 
 Round-the-clock 
 
 
 
Getty Images
 
 
 The stock market is moving toward crypto rails, and fast. OKXICE, the joint venture between crypto exchange OKX and NYSE parent Intercontinental Exchange ( ICE ), has filed with the SEC to launch a tokenized securities platform for the 24/7 trading of U.S. stocks. More than 60 listed companies will initially be available, including popular names like the Magnificent 7. Their shares will become tokens that trade on the blockchain via a liquidity pool and offer the same benefits as equities, such as dividends and voting rights.

 Backdrop: Only two weeks ago, the SEC issued an order to help the rollout of tokenized stocks following the collapse of the Clarity Act in Congress . The looser requirements exempt certain trading venues from the definition of "exchange," as well as exempting certain liquidity providers from the definition of "dealer." The five-year window attached to the order is also intended to give a framework for new market innovations as the Commission evaluates rulemaking and the impacts of new standards.

"Tokenization is the biggest upgrade to financial infrastructure since Wall Street ditched paper for electronic trading," Coinbase ( COIN ) Vice Chair Ryan VanGrack declared following the announcement. "It's no longer a question of whether tokenization will reshape finance—it's a question of where. The innovation exemption is... pulling our financial system into the 21st century."

 Risks and benefits: If all goes well, the tokenization of real-world assets can lead to faster or instant settlement times, access from anywhere in the world, and enhanced operational efficiency. On the other hand, while tokenization can bring more public companies to the blockchain, tokens might be issued by third parties that can be difficult to audit and control. There are also concerns about fragmented markets, price dislocation, and regulatory safeguards, especially with each tokenized stock being paired with stablecoins like USDC ( USDC-USD ), Global Dollar ( USDG-USD ) or Tether USD ( USDT-USD ).
